paragraphs: This means Rav and Shmuel, as in Sanhedrin 17b.[^1]

notes.text: The stored Davidson Sanhedrin17b explicitly gives Our Rabbis in Babylonia as Rav and Shmuel. Retain Hyman's identification formula and the contextual as-in reading of כ; Shmuel receives no added rank.
